hashicorp/boundary.body:
## Changelog

- **workers**: Adds support for multi-hop session routing through nested worker chains ([#4821](https://github.com/hashicorp/boundary/pull/4821))
- **auth**: Now supports OIDC claim-based role mapping without a custom filter ([#4830](https://github.com/hashicorp/boundary/pull/4830))
- Fixed a panic when a target alias resolved to a deleted host set [GH-4844]
- **security**: Session credentials are no longer written to debug-level logs (CVE-2026-1188)
- Deprecated the `-format=table` flag on `boundary sessions list`; use `-format=json`
- Full changelog: https://github.com/hashicorp/boundary/compare/v0.19.1...v0.19.2

- Fixed intermittent connection resets when a worker restarts mid-session ([#4802](https://github.com/hashicorp/boundary/pull/4802))
- **cli**: Adds `--recursive` to `boundary scopes list`

hashicorp/nomad.body:
## IMPROVEMENTS

- **scheduler**: Adds preemption support for system jobs in namespaced clusters ([#20114](https://github.com/hashicorp/nomad/pull/20114))
- **ui**: Now supports filtering the allocations table by client node class

## BUG FIXES

- Fixed a memory leak in the CSI plugin supervisor on repeated volume detach [GH-20130]
- Resolves an issue where `nomad job plan` reported spurious diffs on empty meta blocks

hashicorp/packer.body:
- **hcl2**: Adds `dynamic` blocks inside `source` definitions ([#13402](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13402))
- Breaking: removed the legacy JSON template parser deprecated in 1.9
- Fixed plugin checksum verification failing behind proxies that rewrite content-length

hashicorp/vagrant.body:
- Fixed synced folder permissions on rootless Podman providers [GH-13588]
- **security**: Updated bundled curl to address CVE-2026-0994

hashicorp/consul.body:
- **mesh**: Adds automatic mTLS certificate rotation for external services ([#22540](https://github.com/hashicorp/consul/pull/22540))
- Fixed a race condition in the catalog sync loop under high node churn
